translations.web: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer from God.”
translations.bsb: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.”
translations.kjv: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
translations.asv: And the seers shall be put to shame, and the diviners confounded; yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
